With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institu
data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Head of Engineering Excellence** 
 in our office in Dubai.
 



  





 As the Head of Engineering Excellence, you will…
 



 Be the force that turns Equiti’s engineering principles into everyday practice. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the operating system of the technology organisation — the standards, processes, delivery cadence and metrics that keep a fast\-scaling, multi\-domain engineering org accountable, aligned and continuously improving. You will be the CTO’s trusted partner for execution: making sure the right things get done, by the right owners, to the right standard — without the CTO having to chase.
 



 You will define and enforce how the engineering org works — ways of working, communication and accountability standards, and delivery governance — and make performance visible through engineering KPIs and dashboards. You will lead a culture of Kaizen (continuous improvement), running the cadences and retrospectives that turn data and incidents into lasting improvements across mobile, web, backend, data, platform, QA and trading teams.
 



 You will also be Equiti’s engineering voice to the outside world — championing our work through blogs, talks and conferences, growing our presence in the developer community, and building the technical brand that draws great people to us.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and enforce Equiti’s engineering principles, standards and ways of working across all technology domains.
* Define, track and report engineering KPIs — delivery throughput and predictability, DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change\-failure rate, MTTR), responsiveness/SLA attainment and quality — and turn them into action.
* Run the engineering operating cadence: planning, delivery reviews, incident/postmortem reviews and the operations review that holds owners accountable to SLAs.
* Drive a culture of Kaizen / continuous improvement — facilitate retrospectives, identify systemic bottlenecks, and land process improvements that stick.
* Embed the communication \& accountability framework — ownership/RACI, triage lanes, escalation and channel standards — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Govern cross\-team delivery for major programmes and product launches; surface risks and dependencies early and unblock them.
* Partner with domain leads to raise engineering maturity, consistency and governance — without slowing teams down.
* Act as the CTO’s go to on execution — translate strategy into tracked outcomes, prepare leadership and board\-ready updates, and ensure follow\-through on decisions.
* Champion engineering quality, change management and operational excellence in partnership with SRE / Engineering Platforms.
* Establish lightweight tooling and dashboards (within the ticketing and observability stack) that make standards and metrics self\-serve for every team.
* Lead Equiti’s external engineering evangelism — represent the technology org through conference talks, meetups and panels, and grow our standing in the wider engineering community.
* Own the Equiti engineering blog and technical thought leadership, and shape the engineering employer brand that helps attract and retain top talent.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in software engineering, technical programme management, or engineering operations, with at least 5 years leading process or delivery excellence in scaled engineering organisations.
* Proven track record defining and enforcing engineering principles, ways of working and delivery governance across multiple teams.
* Deep fluency in engineering KPIs and metrics (DORA, delivery predictability, quality, reliability) and in building dashboards that change behaviour.
* Hands\-on experience leading continuous improvement / Kaizen, Agile, and incident/postmortem practices at scale.
* Strong technical credibility — able to hold weight with senior engineers and architects — without needing to be the deepest coder in the room.
* Exceptional influence and stakeholder management; able to enforce standards through trust and clarity, not authority alone.
* A confident public communicator — a track record of external technical writing, conference speaking, or developer\-community engagement (engineering blogs, talks, open source).
* Experience operating as a trusted partner to a CTO or VP of Engineering (programme leadership / execution\-focused role) strongly preferred.
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or regulated industries preferred.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai.



  





  





**Perks** 




  





 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.

* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.

* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.

* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organization by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.

**Team mentorship and development**

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You Will Need For This Position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.

**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.

 This role sit
data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

 Today, it enters a bold and defining new chapter. **Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many future\-facing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, etc.
 



 DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programmess of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 Senior Programme Manager \- lead the design, governance, and delivery of high\-impact Dubai Future Academy programs, translating strategic priorities into structured learning journeys and managing partners, stakeholders, risks, and outcomes across the full program lifecycle.
 



 Dubai Future Academy (DFAc) is the capability building arm of Dubai Future Foundation. It supports Dubai by developing learning opportunities through collaborations with world\-class education providers and subject matter experts. The Senior Program Manager leads complex academy programs by shaping program scope, coordinating partners and subject matter experts, managing delivery governance, and ensuring each learning journey is delivered with strategic clarity, operational excellence, and a strong participant experience.
 



 Senior Program Manager – Dubai Future Academy

**Senior Program Manager – Dubai Future Academy** 




 As Senior Program Manager at DFAc, you will own assigned academy programs from concept and planning through delivery, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role suits someone who can work confidently with senior stakeholders, education partners, faculty, and cross\-functional teams; turn ambiguity into clear plans; and make thoughtful decisions under pressure. You will lead delivery rhythms, manage risks and dependencies, guide coordinators or project support resources, and ensure that every program reflects the quality, ambition, and future\-focused mandate of Dubai Future Foundation.
 



  





**Program Strategy \& Portfolio Planning** 




 • Lead the end\-to\-end design, planning, and delivery of academy programs aligned with Dubai Future Academy priorities and Dubai Future Foundation's future\-focused mandate.
 



 • Translate strategic objectives into clear program scopes, workplans, milestones, budgets, resource plans, and governance rhythms.
 



 • Build and maintain integrated program plans across internal teams, external partners, faculty, venues, communications, and operations.
 



 • Anticipate dependencies, risks, and decisions early, escalating with clear recommendations and practical mitigation options.
 



  





**Stakeholder, Partner \& Faculty Leadership** 




 • Lead day\-to\-day engagement with education providers, subject matter experts, speakers, senior stakeholders, and cross\-functional Dubai Future Foundation teams.
 



 • Shape partner briefs, session requirements, faculty onboarding, and delivery expectations so every contributor understands the program purpose and audience.
 



 • Facilitate planning meetings, executive updates, and decision forums, ensuring actions, owners, and deadlines are clearly captured and closed.
 



 • Build trusted relationships that support collaboration, responsiveness, and high\-quality delivery across the program lifecycle.
 



  





**Program Delivery, Governance \& Risk Management** 




 • Own delivery readiness across program phases, including participant selection, curriculum sequencing, session logistics, operations, technology, and on\-ground execution.
 



 • Lead delivery teams during live programs, resolving issues calmly, making timely decisions, and protecting the participant and stakeholder experience.
 



 • Maintain governance discipline through status reporting, risk registers, issue logs, change control, and post\-program close\-out.
 



  





**Participant Experience \& Executive Communications** 




 • Oversee participant communications, joining instructions, agendas, briefing notes, reminders, and follow\-ups, ensuring messages are accurate, polished, and timely.
 



 Position: Senior Program Manager – Dubai Future Academy Dubai Future Foundation
 



 • Manage participant selection and onboarding processes in coordination with internal stakeholders, partners, and senior reviewers where required.
 



 • Use feedback, attendance, engagement, and operational insights to improve participant experience before, during, and after each program.
 



 • Prepare clear written updates, talking points, summaries, and briefing materials for academy leadership and senior stakeholders.
 



 • Ensure sensitive information, participant data, and stakeholder communications are handled with discretion and appropriate confidentiality.
 



  





**Data, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement** 




 • Define program success measures and ensure relevant data is captured consistently across attendance, satisfaction, learning outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and delivery quality.
 



 • Lead end\-of\-program reporting, synthesizing insights, lessons learned, risks, achievements, and recommended improvements for leadership review.
 



 • Convert feedback and performance data into practical improvements to program design, partner management, delivery processes, and future academy offerings.
 



 • Lead the re\-design and reconceptualisation of programmes year\-on\-year, seeking to not only update content but also evolve the delivery formats, focus areas and objectives.
 



  





  





**Why is this role important?** 




 This role makes a visible impact by turning Dubai Future Academy priorities into high\-quality learning programs that build capability, strengthen future readiness, and connect leaders with world\-class expertise. The Senior Program Manager protects program quality by bringing structure to complex work, aligning stakeholders, managing risks, and ensuring delivery decisions are made with clarity and pace. This role is important to strengthening the Academy's reputation, scaling its impact, and reinforcing Dubai Future Foundation's position as a regional and international thought leader in future\-focused capability building.
 



  





  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to support learning journeys that build leadership capability and future skills. You will work closely with an experienced academy team, engage with senior stakeholders, and support delivery alongside world\-class partners.
 



 You will build practical skills in program delivery, coordination, communications, and reporting, with the chance to learn across multiple initiatives and grow your confidence through hands\-on experience.
 



  





  





**Who We're Looking for?** 




 • You have a bachelor's degree in education, learning and development, project management, or a related field; a master's degree or relevant professional certification is an additional asset.
 



 • You have 8\+ years of experience in program management, executive education, capability building, consulting, government programs, innovation programs, or strategic initiatives.
 



 • You have proven experience leading complex multi\-stakeholder capacity building programs end to end, from concept and planning through delivery, reporting, and continuous improvement.
 



 • You are confident managing senior stakeholders, government entities, universities, training providers, consultants, speakers, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
 



 • You have excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken Arabic is an additional asset.
 



 • You can translate strategic priorities into practical plans, milestones, governance mechanisms, budgets, and delivery decisions.
 



 • You are confident with Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and comfortable using collaboration, reporting, and project management tools.
 



 • You bring strong judgment, attention to detail, and discretion when managing sensitive information, competing priorities, and shifting timelines.
 



 • You are a clear communicator and facilitator who can lead meetings, brief speakers, prepare senior\-level updates, and represent the Academy professionally.
 



 • You are proactive, curious, collaborative, and future\-oriented, with the ability to motivate teams and deliver high\-quality learning experiences.

By owning schedules, scope tracking, project updates, and estimating support inside Primavera and Procore, you will ensure data accuracy, disciplined workflows, and up\-to\-date records that enable the field and leadership teams to execute confidently. data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our
 **Agile Delivery** 
 team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

 The
 **Agile Delivery Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead supplier engagement and governance, including defining SoWs, monitoring SLAs/KPIs, and managing vendor performance to support successful programme delivery. Collaborate with Procurement and Legal teams on commercial evaluations, contract negotiations, and onboarding of strategic technology partners and suppliers.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.

data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

 AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As part of the AbbVie, and Leadership team of AA MEA, develops and/or implements the compliance and governance program across the region. Works to adapt / implement corporate policies and procedures, develop Affiliate SOPs wherever required for the implementation of compliance program, develop and provide relevant training for employees and third parties on compliance related topics. Provides compliance guidance, advice and support to Affiliate and Regional Leadership Teams and General Manager. Monitor compliance due diligence reviews of third parties and compliance vetting of specific transactions. Engages in risk assessment exercises and business projects to ensure compliance requirements are met. Helps identify monitoring needs and perform monitoring activities to minimize compliance risks. Conducts reviews and investigations on specific compliance issues.
   

  

 In addition, the post holder will implement the corporate ethics program across MEA affiliates, adapting the program where necessary and providing ethics training and support.
   

  

**Enterprise Mindset:**
 One of the most crucial elements of the OEC role is cultivating an Enterprise Mindset. Thinking beyond the individual functions of the immediate affiliate and focus on driving value for the entire organization. Making decisions that serve the broader company’s long\-term objectives is cultivating an Enterprise Mindset.
   

  

**Talent Magnet:**
 The ability to attract, develop, and retain talent is crucial to building a strong organization. Being a “Talent Magnet” means that people are drawn to your leadership because of the culture and opportunities you create.
   

  

**Main duties and responsibilities:**
* Commercial Support: 30%
+ Provide guidance and advice to AbbVie Affiliate Leadership Team, commercial teams in country, and/or region across business division, proactively supporting compliance matters to minimize risk.
+ Attends, guides and actively participates in Affiliate/ Regional Leadership Team and Compliance Committee
+ Conduct ongoing risk assessment of third\-party activities and any other areas of activity that require regular review. Conduct routine and ad hoc reviews and resolve noted issues.
+ Monitor due diligence activities as needed for both current and new third parties in accordance with AbbVie policies and procedures.


* Compliance Policies and Procedures: 25%
+ Create and establish appropriate country policies, procedures, and standards to mitigate compliance risk within AA MEA Affiliates. Establish and maintain the training matrix for affiliates and monitor compliance related training completed.
+ Work closely with the regional compliance representatives, MEA leadership team, and Country Manager to understand the risk environment and implement adequate compliance policies, procedures, and standards across the business.
+ Provide guidance on AbbVie and Allergan Aesthetics’ compliance expectations and review both internal and third\-party controls and standards and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve any issues.


* Compliance Training and Monitoring program: 15%
+ Develop and provide relevant, engaging, and interactive compliance training for internal employees and with Allergan Aesthetics’ business partners’ employees or agents, as appropriate.
+ Ensure training materials are effectively and accurately communicated to employees or agents. Update business divisions and other support functions, as appropriate, on relevant compliance news, alerts, and other developments.
+ Support and implement the compliance monitoring program across country with the focus on prevention of compliance issues and appropriate risk management. Perform monitoring, awareness, and education activities across the company.


- Compliance Investigation and Reporting: 20%

* Managing compliance deviations, escalating matters appropriately to International Compliance.
* Support (as needed) ad hoc investigations into potential compliance issues as agreed with International Investigations team.
* Prepare and maintain regular progress reports and updates on compliance reviews for MEA management and International Compliance.
* Identify gaps and pitfalls within current compliance controls to ensure those issues could be resolved or mitigated to prevent potential misconduct.
* Leading People: 10%
* Lead, support, and develop the OEC team enabling them to fulfill their potential.
* Establish, review, and recommend changes for organizational structure so that the structure within the country maximizes organizational performance.
* Lead activities around performance management, talent management, motivation, development, and succession planning for Allergan Aesthetics’ employees.
* Ensure that AbbVie WWW culture is embedded in all business practices.
* External Relationships/ Main Contacts:


 Ensure the development of a broad network of productive relationships with key contacts, opinion leaders, authorities, regulatory authorities and agencies, payers, industry associations, trade, academic, and patient care groups.
   

  

* APAC MEA OEC Director
* Affiliate and Regional Management Teams
* Regional General Manager
* Heads of the functional teams based across MEA Affiliate Countries, including Regulatory, Legal, HR, Finance, and others
* MEA and APAC MEA Compliance Department
* Business partners – distributors, wholesalers and other third parties


**Qualifications**
* Education and Experience:
* University degree or equivalent (scientific, business or legal)
* Minimum of 7 \- 10 years of experience in a senior leadership role, preferably in the pharma, consumer healthcare, or related industries
* Relevant experience working in healthcare compliance role
* Experience in establishing and running compliance programs for ABAC risk
* Excellent communication skills, fluent in English (written and oral)
* Leadership and Management Skills:
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate cross\-functional teams
* Experience managing direct reports and leading a team towards achieving targets and objectives
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify opportunities, develop strategies, and make data\-driven decisions
* Excellent communication and people skills to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at various levels within the organization
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously
* Language and Cultural Competence:
* Fluent in English and proficiency in other languages spoken in the MEA region is highly advantageous
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively in a diverse and multicultural environment
* Travel:
* Willingness to travel within the Affiliate and across the region and occasionally internationally as required for business needs.


 Additional Information
   

  

 AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.
   

  

 US \& Puerto Rico only \- to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join\-us/equal\-employment\-opportunity\-employer.html
   

  

 US \& Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Your mission**
 The Project Director is responsible for driving the successful delivery of projects while actively contributing to the creation and execution of the business plan for future projects.
   

  

 This role goes beyond project leadership \- it’s about strategically shaping our global presence with a primary focus on the Middle East, ensuring operational excellence, and contributing directly to the long\-term growth targets of the Event Production unit.
   

  

 Working closely with the Director of Event Production BU and the wider leadership team, the Project Director will translate the business plans into actionable initiatives, ensure targets are met, maintain and expand client relationships, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.
   

  

 The role also requires close collaboration with other Project Directors across the organisation to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and collective progress toward shared goals.
   

  

 This position reflects our new structure of appointing Project Directors with defined focus areas (e.g., KSA, UAE, Special Projects Global), ensuring scalability and dedicated leadership as our business continues to expand.
   

  

**Leadership \& Strategic Oversight**
* Provide vision, direction, and leadership for project management team.
* Align with the Director of Event Production to deliver on the agreed business plan, targets, and growth strategy.
* Establish clear objectives, OKRs, and performance standards for the Event Production project portfolio.
* Coordinate and collaborate with other Project Directors to ensure alignment of strategies, processes, and delivery standards across all focus areas.
* Drive efficiency, best practices, and continuous improvement in project delivery.
* Mentor, motivate, and support project managers, building a scalable structure that fosters accountability and innovation.


**Project Execution \& Delivery**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and profitability.
* Serve as the senior client\-facing representative, ensuring trust and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
* Define and oversee project structures, including scheduling, budgeting, risk assessment, and resource allocation.
* Ensure disciplined financial and operational management across projects.
* Guarantee compliance with health, safety, and quality standards in close collaboration with QHSE.


**Standardisation \& Best Practices**
* Implement and refine standardised workflows for projects while aligning with global unit standards.
* Apply project management methodologies, documentation, and approval processes that reduce risk and increase efficiency.
* Contribute to structured knowledge\-sharing between all focus areas (KSA, UAE, Special Projects, etc.)


****Client Liaison \& Stakeholder Management****
* Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with existing clients.
* Work closely with the Business Development to identify, approach, and secure new client relationships.
* Act as a senior representative to clients, ensuring clarity of scope, expectations, and outcomes.
* Capture client feedback and integrate it into project delivery and future business planning.
* Nurture partnerships with subcontractors, suppliers, and freelancers to ensure reliable and high\-quality delivery.


****Financial \& Commercial Oversight****
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and margin protection across projects.
* Support the Director of Event Production in financial disciplines, risk management, and profitability strategies.
* Drive commercial success by balancing operational efficiency with exceptional client delivery.


****Innovation \& Continuous Improvement****
* Stay ahead of regional market trends, event production innovations, and project management best practices.
* Translate lessons learned into better processes and future planning for upcoming projects.
* Collaborate across units, regions, and with other Project Directors to ensure creative, technical, and operational excellence.


**Your profile**
* Demonstrated extensive project management experience in turnkey project delivery, including hands\-on experience with AVL and fit\-out installations in the field of events of various complexity and scales.
* Good understanding of technical, business and contractual correlations in all complexity.
* Proven ability to manage large budgets.
* Strong industry network in the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* English language proficiency is a must.
* Flexible to work based on the requirements of the live event industry.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual flight allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Executive\-Level Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://bewunder.com/ Job Function: Event \& Entertainment Management Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Business Consulting and Services
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

**About The Company**
 Searching, interviewing and hiring are all part of the professional life. The TALENTMATE Portal idea is to fill and help professionals doing one of them by bringing together the requisites under One Roof. Whether you're hunting for your Next Job Opportunity or Looking for Potential Employers, we're here to lend you a Helping Hand.

If you suspect any fraud or malpractice, email us at abuse@talentmate.com.
