We are looking for top talent, and your success is our succes
data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent, and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To manage and grow relationships with large and strategic clients within the assigned portfolio in the Retail \& Consumer Goods segment of Wholesale Banking. Drive new business origination while ensuring full compliance with Credit and Risk frameworks. Improve service quality levels and supervise the day‑to‑day activities and client interactions of subordinates to ensure the team consistently meets its objectives and achieves revenue targets, while maintaining strong client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. Promote effective cross‑functional collaboration to deliver integrated financial solutions. Achieving financial targets and strategic objectives will be essential in driving sustainable growth and maintaining profitability.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to execute deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Draft Term Sheets, Information Memorandums, Mandate letters etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions.
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields and sufficient ancillary business.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring quality service and effective resolution of issues.
* Prepare briefing note memos ahead of senior management meetings with clients.
* Engage with internal stakeholders to obtain approvals for client RFPs in a timely manner.
* Increase wallet share with existing clients through strategic engagement and product penetration.
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Be knowledgeable on market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Retail \& Consumer Goods team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Present transactions/proposals to the Credit Allocation Committee (CAC) for approvals.
* Run deal RAROCs and draft CAC submissions, ensuring delivery on CAC promises to achieve target RAROC thresholds.
* Prepare Green Light Memos for deal screening and Client Credit Applications (CAs).
* Review CAs and draft relationship comments before submission to Credit Committees.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Address Credit inquiries, liaise with CAD and Legal for documentation matters.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Retail \& Consumer Goods group and Retails \& Wholesale team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short\- \& long\-term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.


- 


**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* CFA, or master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or Investment Banking with exposure to Retail \& Consumer Goods.
* Strong understanding of credit analysis, trade finance, and treasury products.
* Excellent relationship management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage complex client structures and deliver on strategic objectives.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyze and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 Manages the Loyalty Program activities pertaining to (Air\-rewards) including member acquisition, member engagement, financial performance, program benefits and member communication. He/she shall be responsible for the day\-to\-day operations and the relationships with partners and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Result Responsibilities**
* Develops function related strategies and action plans to achieve Air rewards yearly budgets and financial targets for all Air Arabia network; identifies gaps in performance and recommends new opportunities for growth and revenue maximization.
* Partners with cross\-functional stakeholders such as Marketing \& Corporate Communications, E\-Business and Contact Center to develop and implement targeting promotions and campaigns that are data\-driven and segment\-focused to increase and drive members’ behaviour and engagement in the program.
* Develops processes and assessment tools to monitor the performance of products, channels, routes, and stations and generate reports to keep track of member acquisition, earning, redemptions, incremental revenue, etc.
* Designs and generates ad\-hoc reports as requested by the management.
* Plans and designs the introduction of member tiers along with loyalty products and features designed to improve the Air rewards proposition and drive incremental revenue.
* Streamlines and manages all fulfilment processes for member enrolments, retro\-claims as well as member queries and complaints.
* Conducts market researches and benchmark studies to keep up\-breast with new trends and market development as well as competitors’ practice with respect to loyalty programs and products, thereby, identifies new opportunities for Air rewards revenue streams.
* Develops studies and cost\-effective proposals on new internal and external projects to improve the Air rewards program revenues across the entire network.
* Partners with the different stakeholders and external parties such as loyalty program agency, system providers, Marketing \&Corporate Communications, IT, E\- Business, Contact Center, Commercial Sales, Finance, etc. to ensure successful performance of the loyalty program across the entire network.
* Initiates/builds on business relationships with existing and potential business partners, suppliers and service providers to ensure continuity and development of Air rewards Program and drive incremental revenue.
* Negotiates prices, initiates agreements and contracts with external parties and providers; manages the day\-to\-day relationship with suppliers.
* Performs any other duties as advised by the respective Line Manager.


 Note – The role defined here is not exhaustive and duties and responsibilities in line with the job function may be added from time to time.
   

  

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
 Bachelor degree in Commerce/ Business Management or Administration or/and equivalent
   

  

**Work Experience**
 7\+ years’ experience in frequent flyer programs or airline related loyalty programs in major airline industry 3 of which in a managerial role; experience with low cost airline is a plus.
   

  

 Demonstrates the ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs.
   

  

 Capable of using technology systems and tools; proficient in Microsoft Office (Access is a plus).
   

  

 Fluent in English Language.
   

  

 Previous experience in sales and marketing is desirable for this role.
   

  

 Proven skills in analyzing data, identifying pitfalls and recommending cost\-effective solutions.
   

  

 Product knowledge: capability of understanding market trends and behaviors and translating them into innovative initiatives and solutions.

data.jd_text:
**About Dubai Holding Hospitality:** 




 Dubai Holding Hospitality encompasses a diverse range of assets, including luxury hotels, resorts, and a full\-service F\&B portfolio. The company operates and manages several hotels, resorts, and residences across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia, maintaining a reputation for unmatched luxury and service quality.
 



  





**About the Job:** 



* Ensure the supervision consultants are discharging their onsite duties in accordance with their contracted services.
* Together with the supervision consultants, review and comment on contractor programes, logistics plans, method statements and ensure they are aligned with the business requirements.
* Attend scheduled and ad\-hoc meetings and ensure the supervision consultant chairs the meetings and issues minutes of meetings in a timely manner. In the absence of a supervision consultant, Senior Manager is to perform the same tasks.
* Follow up on open or unresolved items raised by the contractor (RFI’s) with the responsible party to ensure the project is not unnecessarily delayed.
* Monitor the project expenditure to ensure it is aligned with the agreed and approved project budget.
* Provide early warnings of possible variations / additional expenditure requirements.
* Suggest to management mitigation strategies for potential project program delays or cost over\-runs.
* Review interim payment applications and make recommendations for approval and / or deductions.
* Review the consultants and contractors’ quality procedures to ensure works are executed correctly, in accordance with good engineering practice and avoiding abortive works.
* Ensure all project participants adopt best practice HSE protocols.

* Ensure the supervision consultants inspect all aspects of the contracted Works and issue a comprehensive punch / snag list.

 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform.  Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards

* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines

* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams

* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony

**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company

* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.

data.jd_text:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 By concentrating on healthcare’s toughest challenges, we’ve been able to make many major breakthroughs, improving lives around the world. But there’s still work to be done.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join our team.
   

  

 The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society \- from mostly offering world\-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
   

  

 The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co\-create meaningful solutions.
   

  

 This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
   

  

 It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
   

  

**Your Impact**
 The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
   

  

* The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem
* Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non\-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster
* Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community
* Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
* By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co\-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem
* The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs
* Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services


**Who You Are**
* You possess a university degree in a scientific, economic, or business field; an advanced degree in life sciences or an MBA is a plus
* You have a proven track record in leading cross\-functional teams, formulating strategies, and orchestrating execution, with experience partnering with patient advocacy groups (PAGs) being highly desirable
* You demonstrate strong business expertise, particularly in commercialization, medical affairs, and customer experience excellence, and have experience with agile ways of working
* You excel in stakeholder engagement, including partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and organizations, with excellent collaboration and communication skills
* You possess deep knowledge of patient journeys and treatments in defined disease areas, enabling meaningful engagement with specialists and external stakeholders
* You are skilled at leveraging digital tools and innovation methodologies to enhance outcomes and create scalable value
* You demonstrate a growth mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to acting with integrity while navigating complexity and making bold, value\-driven decisions
* You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, enabling seamless collaboration across the Roche global enterprise


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**What you do as a Director Advisory Group** 




 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
 



  





 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
 



  





 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities.  You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
 



  





**Where will you work** 




 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
 



 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
 



  




* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders



  





**What we offer** 




 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
 


* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance



  





**Are you our new colleague?** 




 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
 



 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
 



 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
 



  





 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
 



***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction

 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual

* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
الهدف العام للوظيفة
 



 قيادة وتطوير استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة، وتحمّل المسؤولية المؤسسية عن تحقيق القيمة المضافة من خلال توظيف أصول بيانات الوزارة ومنظومة الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وتحقيق الربط الفعّال بين التوجهات الاستراتيجية للوزارة وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لقيادة مسيرة تبنّيه في مختلف قطاعاتها، وضمان توافق جميع المبادرات مع المعايير الأخلاقية ومتطلبات الحوكمة بما يعزز كفاءة اتخاذ القرار ويحقق أهداف التحول الذكي.
 



  





 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 


* إعداد وقيادة استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي للوزارة بما يتوافق مع أهدافها المؤسسية والوطنية، وتطوير نموذج التشغيل اللازم لتنفيذها وقياس أثرها في تحسين الكفاءة واتخاذ القرار.
* قيادة مبادرات التحول الذكي في الوزارة بما فيها تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، واستثمار أصول البيانات المؤسسية لتحقيق قيمة مضافة قابلة للقياس.
* ضمان قابلية توسع نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتكاملها مع سير العمل والأنظمة المؤسسية القائمة، مع ضمان جاهزية البيانات لمتطلبات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إنشاء وإدارة أطر حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة بما يشمل السياسات والمعايير ونماذج التشغيل، لضمان الاستخدام الأخلاقي والمسؤول وفق المعايير المحلية والدولية.
* تصميم وتطبيق إطار إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تصنيف المخاطر وآليات التخفيف والمراقبة المستمرة لحماية الوزارة من الآثار السلبية المحتملة.
* الإشراف على تقييم واعتماد حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان امتثالها لمتطلبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات والاشتراطات التنظيمية المعتمدة.
* التنسيق مع قيادات الوحدات والإدارات لتعزيز القدرات الذكية عبر الوزارة، وبناء ثقافة مؤسسية تثق في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتوظّفه بصورة فعّالة.
* التعاون مع الفرق التقنية لضمان أن البنية التحتية وعمليات تقنية المعلومات وهندسة البرمجيات وإدارة البيانات تدعم تشغيل حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي واستدامتها.
* متابعة أداء وأثر مبادرات الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان تحقيق القيمة وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المعتمدة، وإعداد التقارير الدورية لقيادة الوزارة.
* تصميم وتنفيذ برامج التثقيف في الذكاء الاصطناعي وبناء القدرات التقنية لدى منسوبي الوزارة بما يضمن قدرتهم على التعامل مع أدواته وتطبيقاته بفاعلية.
* التواصل مع الجهات التنظيمية والشركاء الخارجيين والهيئات المعنية في شأن حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي واستراتيجيته.
* الإسهام في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية السنوية للقسم ومتابعة تنفيذها وضمان توافقها مع أولويات الوزارة الاستراتيجية.
* تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يكلف بها مدير الإدارة في نطاق اختصاصه.



  





 المؤهلات والخبرة
 


* دكتوراه \- إحصاء / رياضيات تطبيقية / اقتصاد / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (بدون خبرة)
* ماجستير \- الذكاء الاصطناعي / علوم البيانات / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (3 سنوات)
* بكالوريوس \- علوم الحاسب / هندسة الحاسوب / هندسة البرمجيات / نظم المعلومات أو ما يعادلها (7 سنوات)



  





 الشهادات المهنية
 


* شهادة مهنية معتمدة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة مثل Google Professional ML Engineer / AWS ML Specialty / Azure AI Engineer Associate
* شهادة في الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة مثل LLMs DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization
* شهادة في حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي وأخلاقياته مثل IAPP AI Governance Professional / ISO 42001 Lead Implementer
* شهادة في علم البيانات وتحليل البيانات المتقدمة مثل IBM Data Science Professional / Databricks ML Associate
* شهادة في تشغيل نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وعملياته مثل MLflow MLOps Certified / Kubeflow Practitioner
* شهادة في إدارة المشاريع والتحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله ا PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* شهادة في إدارة البيانات وهندستها أو ما يعادلها (CDMP)
* دورة في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيقاته في القطاع الحكومي
* دورة في أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستخدام المسؤول ومعالجة التحيز والشفافية
* دورة في قيادة التغيير وإدارة التحول المؤسسي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
* دورة في هندسة الطلبات وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Prompt Engineering)



  





  





  





  





  





**Job Purpose** 




 Lead and develop the Ministry's Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy and assume enterprise\-wide responsibility for delivering measurable value through the effective utilization of the Ministry's data assets and AI ecosystem, including Generative AI applications. The role ensures the alignment of AI technologies with the Ministry's strategic objectives, drives AI adoption across all sectors, and ensures that all AI initiatives comply with ethical standards and governance requirements, thereby enhancing decision\-making efficiency and achieving the Ministry's smart transformation goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and lead the Ministry's AI strategy in alignment with its organizational and national objectives, including designing the operating model required for implementation and measuring its impact on operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* Lead smart transformation initiatives across the Ministry, including Generative AI applications, while leveraging enterprise data assets to create measurable business value.
* Ensure AI models are scalable and seamlessly integrated with existing enterprise systems and business processes, while ensuring data readiness for AI implementation.
* Establish and manage the Ministry's AI governance framework, including policies, standards, and operating models, to ensure ethical and responsible AI usage in accordance with local and international standards.
* Design and implement an AI risk management framework, including risk classification, mitigation mechanisms, and continuous monitoring to protect the Ministry from potential adverse impacts.
* Oversee the evaluation and approval of AI use cases, ensuring compliance with privacy, data protection, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with business unit and departmental leaders to strengthen AI capabilities across the Ministry and foster an organizational culture that trusts and effectively utilizes AI.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure that IT infrastructure, software engineering practices, and data management capabilities support the deployment, operation, and sustainability of AI solutions.
* Monitor the performance and impact of AI initiatives, ensuring value realization against approved Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and prepare periodic reports for the Ministry's leadership.
* Design and implement AI awareness and capability\-building programs to enhance employees' technical skills and effective use of AI tools and applications.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities, external partners, and relevant organizations on AI governance, strategy, and compliance matters.
* Contribute to the preparation of the department's annual operational plans, monitor their implementation, and ensure alignment with the Ministry's strategic priorities.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Department Director within the scope of the role.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **PhD** 
 in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (no experience required).
* **Master's Degree** 
 in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (minimum 3 years of experience).
* **Bachelor's Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (minimum 7 years of experience).



**Professional Certifications** 



* Professional certification in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, such as
 **Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer** 
 ,
 **AWS Machine Learning Specialty** 
 , or
 **Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate** 
 .
* Certification in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), such as the
 **DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization** 
 .
* Certification in AI Governance and Ethics, such as
 **IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP)** 
 or
 **ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer** 
 .
* Certification in Data Science and Advanced Data Analytics, such as
 **IBM Data Science Professional Certificate** 
 or
 **Databricks Machine Learning Associate** 
 .
* Certification in AI Operations (MLOps), such as
 **MLflow MLOps Certified** 
 or
 **Kubeflow Practitioner** 
 .
* Certification in Project Management and Digital Transformation, such as
 **PMP** 
 ,
 **PRINCE2** 
 , or
 **SAFe** 
 .
* Certification in Data Management and Data Engineering, such as
 **Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)** 
 .
* Training course in AI Strategy and its applications in the government sector.
* Training course in AI Ethics, Responsible AI, Bias Mitigation, and Transparency.
* Training course in Change Leadership and Enterprise Transformation using AI technologies.
* Training course in Prompt Engineering and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

data.jd_text:
**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.

Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:**

* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities

* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms

* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems

* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)

* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience

* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)

* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
