data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

* Contribute to investor outreach campaigns across portfolio events with the marketing and cross\-functional teams.


* Provide investor program cover for senior team members during high\-volume pre\-event and on\-ground periods.

* Track investor programme KPIs across assigned events: investor count, AUM represented, meetings held, investment signals generated, and investor NPS.


* Conduct post\-event investor debriefs, gather feedback, and share improvement recommendations with the program lead.

* Strong written English is mandatory; Arabic is a meaningful advantage.

 Deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making is the non\-negotiable. data.jd_text:
The Opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking an Account Director with expertise in public affairs, government relations, and strategic communications. This professional will have a strong background in policy advocacy, issues management, stakeholder engagement, and project leadership. The successful candidate will join our growing Public Affairs practice in Riyadh, contributing to high\-profile campaigns that align with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 and other national priorities.
   

  

 What we’re looking for:
   

 We are seeking a proactive, high‑performing Public Affairs professional who can operate confidently as both a leader and a team player, a balance widely recognized as essential for effective performance and for driving collective success. You bring the ability to lead with purpose while collaborating seamlessly within a broader team environment, reflecting modern leadership expectations where leaders also act as active players when needed.
   

 You have a strong track record in public affairs, issues management, and strategic communications, with a deep understanding of Saudi Arabia’s regulatory and policy landscape. You excel at building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, clients, and partners, and you bring the judgment and agility required to navigate complex, fast‑moving policy environments. You inspire confidence, elevate team performance, and deliver high‑impact results while growing across sectors and communication channels.
   

 Responsibilities:
   

 \- Design and Lead strategic public affairs programs that shape policy conversations and advance organizational priorities, aligning with the core PA function of directing information and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 \- Monitor, analyze, and interpret regulatory and policy developments in Saudi Arabia to provide clear, actionable insights aligned with strategic communication goals
   

  

 \- Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, industry stakeholders, and partners to support effective issue management and influence public perception.
   

  

 \- Develop integrated communication strategies across traditional media, digital platforms, and stakeholder channels to support credibility and reputation management, consistent with Public Affairs Officer roles.
   

  

 \- Provide strategic counsel on emerging issues, risks, and opportunities, supporting leadership decision‑making and enhancing the organization’s public positioning
   

  

 \- Collaborate closely with cross‑regional teams to ensure alignment between global and regional public affairs priorities, reflecting modern PA team structures and leadership expectations.
   

  

 \- Prepare and oversee the development of briefing materials, policy positions, and stakeholder engagement plans to ensure consistent high‑quality outputs that strengthen the organization’s narrative.
   

  

 \- Support multi‑stakeholder initiatives, events, and advocacy efforts that advance business objectives and reinforce organizational credibility across key audiences.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

 \- Experience: 10\+ years in public affairs, government relations, policy advocacy, or strategic communications, with strong preference for experience navigating Saudi Arabia’s policy and regulatory environment.
   

  

 \- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Communications, International Relations, or a related field.
   

  

 \- Language Skills: Full professional fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
   

  

 \- Policy \& Cultural Insight: Deep understanding of Saudi Arabia’s political ecosystem, policymaking processes, government stakeholders, and national initiatives such as Vision 2030\.
   

  

 \- Policy Writing \& Analysis: Strong ability to craft policy positions, briefing notes, and advocacy messaging, backed by sharp analytical skills and the ability to simplify complex issues.
   

  

 \- Leadership: Proven track record leading public affairs teams, managing multi‑market workstreams, and guiding stakeholder engagement strategies.
   

  

 \- Stakeholder \& Media Engagement: Experience engaging with government ministries, regulators, industry bodies, and media; comfortable drafting public statements, managing narratives, and supporting issue management.
   

  

 \- Project \& Issue Management: Ability to manage fast‑moving policy files, coordinate cross‑functional inputs, and deliver high‑quality outputs under pressure.
   

  

 \- Industry Knowledge: Experience working across sectors such as healthcare, technology, energy, transportation, or government sectors is a plus.
   

  

  

 Careers at APCO
   

 Through our recruitment, hiring and retention efforts, APCO is committed to building teams to bring the best possible expertise and robust perspectives to our clients. We embrace differences in experience, viewpoint and ideas, starting with our values and extending to our behaviors, policies and practices. We aim to create a positive work experience and welcoming environment where everyone feels they belong and can thrive.

 Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.

* Executive stakeholder management
* Commercial acumen and market development
* Proposal and pursuit leadership

 We are seeking a commercially minded sustainability leader who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to develop client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and build high\-performing teams. The successful candidate will be a market\-facing leader capable of supporting EY's continued expansion across Saudi Arabia's sustainability and transformation agenda.

data.jd_text:
Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 This is an opportunity to work on one of the largest programmes in Saudi Arabia. This unique project consists of major mixed\-use development including sports facilities, entertainment and arts along with all associated infrastructure.
   

  

 The Recovery Director shall be responsible for leading and driving the recovery of a distressed or underperforming project through the proactive monitoring, management and coordination of the Main Contractor, subcontractors, consultants and associated stakeholders.
   

  

 The role is focused on restoring confidence in project delivery by implementing robust planning, progress monitoring, resource management, coordination, reporting and recovery initiatives to ensure achievement of contractual milestones, sectional completion dates, operational readiness requirements and overall project completion.
   

  

**You'll Be Responsible For**
* Review and assess the contractor’s baseline programme, recovery programme, critical path, sequencing and milestone strategy.
* Monitor progress against approved schedules, contractual milestones, and recovery targets. Identify delays, productivity issues, logic deficiencies, coordination failures and resource constraints impacting delivery.
* Develop, implement, and monitor project recovery and mitigation strategies. Validate programme updates, look\-ahead schedules and recovery initiatives submitted by the contractor.
* Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance across all disciplines and work fronts. Identify underperforming subcontractors and recommend corrective actions or replacement strategies where required.
* Ensure subcontractor interfaces, work sequencing and trade coordination are effectively managed.
* Chair and lead recovery, coordination and performance meetings.
* Monitor workface availability, access constraints, design impacts, procurement delays, testing and commissioning readiness and authority approvals.
* Coordinate with consultants, designers, contractors, operators and authorities to remove obstacles to delivery.
* Support assessment of recovery\-related costs, acceleration measures and mitigation proposals.
* Provide input into contractual notifications relating to delays, non\-performance, or recovery obligations.
* Monitor impacts to sectional completion, taking over milestones, operational readiness and stakeholder interfaces.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years’ experience in large\-scale construction and project delivery.
* Strong understanding of Primavera P6, critical path analysis, recovery planning, construction sequencing, testing and commissioning, operational readiness and contract administration.
* Demonstrated experience managing contractors and subcontractors on large multidisciplinary projects.
* Experience within hospitality, entertainment, infrastructure, or giga\-project environments preferred.
* Experience within delivery partner / PMC environments preferred.
* Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and have relevant work experience working on high valued projects/programmes for a project management consultancy business, which are required for immigration and client approval.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** 
 We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long\-term relationships with our clients.
   

  

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will be responsible for providing overall leadership, strategic direction, and execution oversight for the conventional railway and freight rail project from award through delivery. The role requires a seasoned delivery leader with extensive experience in major conventional rail and freight rail infrastructure projects, with the ability to direct multidisciplinary teams, manage stakeholder and client relationships, oversee complex interfaces, and drive successful outcomes across all phases of delivery in line with schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational objectives
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead the overall planning, execution, and delivery of the railway project.
* Provide strategic and operational leadership across all project functions.
* Manage project delivery performance with a focus on schedule, cost, quality, safety, and risk.
* Oversee multidisciplinary teams including engineering, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the client, consultants, authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and company standards.
* Drive project governance, reporting, decision\-making, and performance management processes.
* Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, and issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support bid\-stage planning, methodology development, staffing strategy, and delivery planning as required.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support successful project execution.
* Ensure a strong culture of HSE, quality assurance, and operational excellence across the project.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 25 years of total experience in large\-scale infrastructure and construction projects.
* Mandatory prior experience in conventional railway and freight rail projects.
* Proven project delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from initiation to completion.
* Prior experience in a Project Director or similarly senior leadership role, ideally on major conventional and freight railway projects.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of project management principles, contract administration, commercial management, and project controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, multicultural, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent client management, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of HSE, quality, risk, and compliance requirements for major projects, including conventional and freight railway systems.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

 The role will act as the Owner's lead representative for all Depot, Rollingstock and Systems scope, ensuring that they are coordinated and integrated with the VST package and that the metro system overall is delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with operational, technical, regulatory, and programme requirements.
   

  

 A key challenge of the role is managing complex interfaces between railway systems, civil infrastructure, operational assets, utility providers, government stakeholders, developers, future operators, and contractors within a rapidly developing city where some surrounding infrastructure is operational while other assets remain under design and construction.
   

  

 The DRSS Director works closely with the separate Viaduct, Stations and Tunnels (VST) package to achieve the overall integrated delivery outcome across both packages, and subsequent delivery to the Operator/Maintainer. This includes managing complex design interfaces across packages, regulatory bodies, utility providers and adjacent asset owners.
   

  

 The role also leads, develops, and supports a high\-performing team, setting clear expectations, building capability, and fostering a collaborative culture focused on safety, accountability, and successful project outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead strategy, delivery, and governance for depot facilities, rolling stock, track, and railway systems.
* Oversee design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover of depot infrastructure.
* Manage rolling stock procurement, supplier performance, testing, acceptance, and lifecycle requirements.
* Provide leadership across railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, traction power, E\&M systems, platform screen doors, AFC, cybersecurity, track, and depot systems.
* Ensure systems integration, interface management, configuration control, safety assurance, and regulatory compliance.
* Coordinate interfaces with civil works, utilities, roads, developers, operators, regulators, and third\-party stakeholders.
* Lead testing, commissioning, trial operations, and operational readiness activities to support successful service commencement.
* Support procurement, contract management, technical approvals, change control, claims review, and commercial negotiations.
* Drive risk management, quality assurance, safety culture, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle


**Requirements**
****Qualifications****
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Railway Engineering, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
* Professional Engineering registration or equivalent accreditation.
* Master's degree, Chartered Engineer (CEng), PE, PMP, or similar certification preferred.


****Experience****
* Minimum 20 years of experience in railway, metro, transit, or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Proven client\-side leadership experience on large rail programmes.
* Strong background in depot development, rolling stock delivery, railway systems integration, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary international teams and complex stakeholder interfaces.
* Preferred experience with driverless metro systems, greenfield metro projects, and international railway standards (EN).


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision\-making.
* Railway systems integration, rolling stock engineering, depot operations, safety, and asset management.
* Programme delivery, interface management, risk management, contract administration, and change management.

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
   

  

 AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work\-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 This is an exciting time to join our growing Middle East Digital and Technology team. You will be able to help evolve our offerings in a number of our core sectors as we are supporting our clients to tackle some of their most complex business problems. You will take an integral role in identifying, shaping and cultivating new opportunities to work with clients, much of the time in close partnership with other areas of the firm.
   

  

 This Director opportunity is a permanent position located in Riyadh and reports to a Partner.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be at home operating at the intersection of business strategy and technology, partnering with corporate C\-suite executives and Private Equity Operating Partners to drive business growth, transformation, and long\-term value creation.
   

  

 We bring a distinctive combination of deep technical expertise and sharp commercial acumen to deliver sustainable impact hands\-on.
   

  

 Examples of our past work include helping some of the world’s best known companies leverage technology to realise their business objectives, working with private equity investors to evolve their company portfolios, and supporting high\-profile turnaround cases.
   

  

 This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.

* Industry experience preferred in Telecom, Retail, Oil \& Gas

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, Arabic is advantageous
* Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
* Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
* Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation

 Working hours: 8:30am – 5:30pm, Sunday to Thursday, hybrid model
   

  

*The firm offers market\-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs, you can read more about the AlixPartners benefits here.*

**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 11,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra) team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 A\&M continues to expand in EMEA, and we are looking to recruit a Director \& Senior Director to be based in our Riyadh office. Working with some of the industry's brightest and most experienced colleagues, you will:
   

  

* Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the assigned tasks.

* Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.
* Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery.


**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in project management and business development, ideally within consulting or related industries.
* 8\+ years experience within public sector large scale projects experience is necessary.
* Arabic language skills is required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of articulating ideas to diverse audiences.
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation.
* Thrives in a high\-energy, fast\-paced, and dynamic culture.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
   

  

 We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

 Culture \& Values
   

  

 At Alvarez \& Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here.
   

  

 Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters
   

  

 Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

data.jd_text:
A reputable financial technology company, is looking for a seasoned Project Delivery Manager who combines rigorous delivery discipline with deep techno\-functional knowledge of fintech platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will own client implementations end to end, driving structured execution while also being the person who understands how the company's modules work, can engage meaningfully in technical discussions, and bridges business needs with platform capabilities.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a delivery leadership role that demands both craft and substance.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
**Project Delivery and Governance:**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the company's implementation projects, from kickoff through post\-go\-live, across fintech and financial services clients in the GCC.
* Develop and maintain key project documentation, Project Charters, delivery plans, RAID logs, and progress reports, structured to drive alignment, not just record\-keeping.
* Lead steering committee engagements. Presenting delivery status, managing escalations, and keeping senior stakeholders on both sides informed and aligned.
* Manage project budgets, timelines, dependencies, and risks while maintaining compliance with SAMA and GCC regulatory and governance frameworks.
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams. Aligning engineering, product, and client stakeholders around clear ownership, priorities, and delivery milestones.
* Contribute to the company's PMO. Improving delivery frameworks, reporting standards, and implementation playbooks as the function scales.


**Techno\-Functional \& Client:**
* Build deep functional knowledge of the company's modules: payments, collections, disbursements, cards, lending, open banking, so you can guide configuration decisions and resolve ambiguity without constantly escalating to product or engineering.
* Engage meaningfully in technical integration reviews, understand gaps before they become delivery blockers.
* Contribute in functional workshops, translating client business requirements into platform configurations and delivery scope that both engineering teams and clients can commit to.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to clients, building long\-term relationships through transparency, delivery excellence, and a genuine understanding of their business.
* Stay current on digital banking trends, payments innovation, and emerging technologies to keep the company's delivery approach sharp and forward\-looking.


****Role Requirements:****
**Experience \& Background:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 6–10 years in project management or delivery roles within consulting, fintech, or banking technology in the GCC with a track record of owning complex implementations end to end.
* Proven experience in team leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and task allocation across multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.
* Proven experience delivering complex core banking or retail banking implementations, or end\-to\-end card management programs is a must.
* Previous experience in Product Management or Techno\-Functional Role is a plus


**Project Management Skills:**
* Strong command of project planning, risk management, dependency tracking, and budget oversight across the full delivery lifecycle.
* Fluency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, comfortable adapting the approach to the project context rather than defaulting to one.
* Hands\-on with modern PM tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent with documentation and reporting treated as a first\-class habit.
* Solid understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and SAMA regulatory frameworks in Saudi Arabia's fintech landscape.


**Techno\-Functional Skills:**
* Basic functional understanding of payments infrastructure: how payment rails, collections, disbursements, reconciliation, and open banking flows work end to end.
* Enough technical depth to engage in API integration discussions and spot where integration decisions will create downstream issues.
* Ability to contribute in functional requirement workshops producing specs that engineering and clients both trust.
* Capacity to make independent platform and configuration decisions, you understand the product deeply enough to resolve grey areas without constant escalation.


**Soft Skills \& Culture:**
* Strong communication and presentation skills, equally effective in a C\-level steering committee and a technical integration review.
* People\-first leadership, you build trust quickly, create clarity in ambiguity, and foster collaboration across delivery teams without micromanaging.
* Ownership mindset, you take accountability for outcomes, not just activities, and you bring adaptability and maturity to fast\-moving environments.
* Arabic Native and very good English command is a must for client\-facing contexts across the GCC.


****Nice to Have:****
* Experience delivering API\-first, open banking, or embedded finance platforms in a SaaS environment.
* Previous experience in product management or techno\-functional consultancy.
* Background in solution consulting, pre\-sales, or functional analysis for fintech or banking platforms.
* Familiarity with core banking systems or payment switching infrastructure.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications.

**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description:**
 Aviagen is establishing a new world\-class operation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), comprising farms, a hatchery, a feed mill, a laboratory, and a decontamination facility across multiple locations.
   

  

 To support the successful delivery of this ambitious project, Aviagen has partnered with GPP, a specialist consulting firm with extensive expertise in the design, management, and supervision of poultry industry construction projects.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to join the project team and work closely with both GPP and Aviagen stakeholders throughout the construction phase.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Reporting to the Project Director, the Project Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and control of construction projects, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in accordance with the required quality and safety standards.
   

  

 Acting as the Owner's Representative, the Project Manager will safeguard Aviagen's interests throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that business objectives, contractual commitments, and strategic priorities are achieved.
   

  

 The role serves as the primary coordination point between the Project Director, site supervisors, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders, providing leadership throughout construction, commissioning, and final handover.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of projects, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
* Report regularly to the Project Director and Senior Project Management Team on project performance, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate and manage relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Act as the key interface between engineering disciplines and site teams, ensuring the accurate implementation of designs and technical specifications.
* Provide direction and oversight to site supervisors and ensure consistency in decision\-making and project execution.
* Monitor project progress against established schedules and proactively implement corrective actions where required.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, change orders, and cost control measures.
* Review and approve progress certificates, contractor claims, variation orders, and payment applications.
* Lead, coordinate, and support the site supervision team across multiple project locations.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, project specifications, quality standards, HSE requirements, and local regulatory requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while effectively managing project changes.
* Chair project meetings and ensure timely follow\-up and closure of action items.
* Prepare and deliver regular project status reports, highlighting progress, key achievements, risks, and critical decisions.


**Required**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, construction management, or major capital projects.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale industrial, agricultural, infrastructure, or manufacturing construction projects.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, contract administration, project controls, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management.
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and consultants.
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing project costs and contractual matters.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, scheduling tools, and reporting systems.
* Fluent in English.


**Preferred**
* Experience within poultry, agribusiness, food production, or industrial facility construction projects.
* Previous experience working in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region.
* Familiarity with KSA construction regulations, permitting processes, and local business practices.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar project management tools.
* English is a must \& Arabic language skills would be an advantage.


 What We Offer
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to play a leading role in one of Aviagen's most significant strategic investments in the region. The successful candidate will work alongside international experts and contribute to the successful delivery of a world\-class poultry production operation in Saudi Arabia.

 Context

**Overview**
 The Market Director – Rail shall develop and oversee all service delivery, inclusive of win work, client management and delivery of services for clients \& projects for the Rail Market for the Middle East. They shall be directly responsible for the performance of the Rail Market from a revenue and EBIT perspective as outlined within the Markets yearly targets.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Profitable Delivery**
* Overall responsibility for the Rail Market within the Middle East business. This includes but is not limited to:
* Bid Reviews \& Bid Drafting – Undertake the role of Project Director and/or Market Director during the bid process and manage the bid process in its entirety. Develop win themes and retain responsibility for successfully pricing projects. As required manage the bid budget and liaise with the business to identify and engage the correct SME's (supported by Capabilities) for bid development and answers.
* KAM \& Client Development – KAM \& Client Development activities are to be undertaken with a primary focus on the Market (secondary focus being alignment and support to other Markets and Accounts). This is to be service agnostic, and the principal focus is in developing profitable and resilient Client relationships. Accounts will define best practice and support selection of client account managers (training and development).
* Bid Reporting – Provide weekly feedback and insight confirming available opportunities and outlining decisions on which bids to respond to.
* Proactive Win Work – Engage proactively with clients to define opportunities prior to bids being released and incorporate these opportunities into our CRM and future opportunities pipeline.
* Revenue Management – Proactively manage Revenue and EBIT KPI's throughout the year utilising the financial tools and techniques as defined by the business.
* Capture Planning – Lead 'Client Value Proposition' workshops \& strategy development to align services with client needs (supported by Capabilities).
* Working at Risk – Responsible for the development of working at risk strategies and provide recommendations for relevant approvers.
* Starting the Job Right – Responsible and Accountable for the implementation of successful project start up including but not limited to Project Risk Management, Stakeholder Management and Project Management plans.
* Project Review (process) – Lead project review process and proactive management of commercial performance.


**Market Lead – Operational Excellence**
* Market Director – Rail shall ensure that the best tools, techniques and approaches are utilised across your Market (supported by Capabilities). Identify new ways of working where required that will improve the commercial performance of your Market. This includes:
* Process \& Procedures – Define, administer and develop Market specific tools and techniques. Ensure clarity on the process, its application and the relevant training and communications to ensure compliant adoption throughout the Market.
* Market Risk Management – Advise the business on Market risks and the relevant mitigation plans. Create a quarterly Market risk management plan and issue to key leaders and stakeholders within the business.
* Market Trends – Identify, through either direct relationships or analytical tools, key trends within the Market and provide specific action plans as required to develop AtkinsRéalis capability to meet the needs of the Market.
* Project Delivery Oversight – Accountability and Responsibility for all Market projects and clients to ensure that delivery aligns with the contractual commitments and manage team performance accordingly.


**Leadership \& Management**
* Establish and develop the overall behaviours for success within the Market. Ensuring positive behaviours and responsibilities are encouraged, developed and endorsed in the management of the following:
* Organisation Design \& Operating Model – Collaboration with the Strategy \& Transformation Team (Responsible) to review, develop and approve any adjustments to the Market operating model. This is inclusive of organisation design, organisation interface definition and assignment of roles and responsibilities.
* Collaborative Behaviours – Lead by example and demonstrate critical behaviours of accountability, inspiration, collaboration, inclusivity and integrity.
* Learning \& Development – Identify and drive development and inspire the Market resources in line with both the organisation goals and the career aspirations of the individuals.
* Market Team Budget \& Deployment – Deliver the operational oversight and management activities in line with the Budget provided by the SVP Infrastructure Market. Ensure the team is appropriately sized to achieve EBIT and utilisation targets.
* Training – Identify and if required deliver Market based training to improve the capability of the wider business as required.
* Technical Excellence – Oversee and ensure best in class delivery of Market projects.
* Lessons Learnt – Retain and develop a lesson learnt log across the Market activities. Identify areas for improvement and collaboratively develop robust and clear action plans. Communicate pertinent lessons learnt to the business.
* Digital Transformation – Focus on the incorporation of 'digital' into services to create value propositions.
* PDR \& Team Development – Define and assist inclusively in the successful delivery of PDR's'and career development for resources within the Market (supported by Capabilities).


**Key Interfaces (Others)**
* Marketing and Communications – Develop a Market specific 'Marketing and Communications' Strategy outlining what the approach is to engage with the wider Market to drive AtkinsRéalis business performance.
* Thought Leadership – Produce thought leadership articles and papers in alignment with the Market 'Marketing and Communications' Strategy.
* Peer Review – As required provide Peer Review activities for adjacent Capability, Markets and Accounts.
* Performance Feedback (service levels) – Communicate to business feedback on Market performance – deliverables, people, financial \- positive or negative (integrity).


**Key Performance Indicators**
 The Market Director – Rail shall develop and oversee all service delivery, inclusive of win work, client management and delivery of services for clients \& projects for the Rail Market for the Middle East. They shall be directly responsible for the performance of the Rail Market from a revenue and EBIT perspective as outlined within the Markets yearly targets.
   

  

 The various measurable aspects to this role and associated KPI's'are as follows:
   

  

* Market Strategy – Market performance aligned with LRP, Business Plan and proposed targets specific to Rail. This includes achieving targets for P\&L, EBIT and Headcount.
* Win Work Regional Bid Performance – Achieve commission win rate of over 50% on bids submitted in line with the LRP target areas.
* Business Development (cross selling) – Support the business in strategies for identifying new clients and or market opportunities – both Cities and Communities and holistically for AtkinsRéalis.
* Resource Demand – Management of resources specific to the Rail Market providing leadership in recruitment, retention and performance. Ensure Rail resource is managed in line with the Overhead budget as provided during the business planning cycle. Support the strategic resource demand planning of Capability resources for cross business allocation.
* Resource Management – Development of talent including delivery of 9\-box grid, succession plans and training identification for the Rail Market (supported by Capabilities).
* Leadership \& Vision (Accountable, Inspiring, Inclusive, Collaborative \& Integrity) – Provide leadership and demonstrate positive AtkinsRéalis behaviours with performance defined by team feedback through pulse surveys and other feedback avenues (as prescribed by HR).
* LRP \& business plans – Responsible for management and development of Rail business and LRP strategy. Provide updates monthly on Rail progress against defined targets (Clients, EBIT, Revenue etc.).
* Future Business Plan development – Responsibility for developing, drafting, gaining necessary approvals and implementing short, medium and long\-term business plans for the Rail Market.


**About You**
* Extensive Profit \& Loss management capabilities.
* Provide oversight and lead fee proposals and ensure fee proposals are competitive and profitable based on their extensive experience.
* Regional SME (subject matter expert) for Rail \- Proven and strong client network in the Rail market across the GCC with both owners and operators.
* Excellent presentation skills \- Lead in Market specific Marketing and Business Development.
* Represent the business at functions selling our expertise and Market knowledge.
* Regional mentor for top talent.
* Direct experience running a successful P\&L.
* Background in Rail – preferably client experience.
* Degree in a related discipline and/or Minimum 15 years' experience.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**

* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

 In addition, the role will establish AI governance frameworks, executive reporting mechanisms, investment evaluation criteria, and portfolio performance dashboards to support executive decision\-making.

 Experience within diversified organisations, consulting firms, or large enterprise transformation programmes will be highly regarded.

 The Director will work closely with subsidiary leadership teams to identify automation opportunities, redesign business processes, coordinate solution implementation with technology partners, and ensure successful adoption across multiple business sectors.
   

  

 The role will also establish implementation standards, vendor governance, solution architecture principles, and performance metrics to maximise return on AI investments.

 Strong knowledge of enterprise AI platforms, process automation, vendor management, cloud technologies, and enterprise application integration is essential.
   

  

 Experience working across multiple industries and managing complex technology transformation programmes within large organisations is highly desirable.

**Position Summary** 

 The Assistant Director of Catering Sales supports the Director in managing the catering sales department to achieve revenue goals and maintain high service standards. This role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the sales team, managing key accounts, and ensuring that all sales processes—from lead inquiry to final execution—are handled with precision. The successful candidate will act as a mentor to junior staff and take the lead on special projects to improve department efficiency.
 


**Key Responsibilities** 
* **Sales Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Assist the Director in supervising the sales team, providing day\-to\-day guidance on lead conversion, contract negotiation, and upselling techniques.
* **Operational Oversight:** 
 Review all Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and contracts for accuracy before they are circulated to the operations and culinary teams. Ensure all departmental SOPs are strictly followed.
* **Key Account Management:** 
 Directly manage a portfolio of high\-value corporate and social clients, ensuring consistent engagement and retention.
* **Reporting \& Analysis:** 
 Compile weekly and monthly sales reports for the Director. Analyze performance data to identify gaps in the pipeline and suggest adjustments to sales strategies.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** 
 Act as the liaison between the sales department and the kitchen/operations teams. Lead weekly team briefings to ensure all departments are prepared for upcoming events.
* **Process Improvement:** 
 Identify areas for improvement in existing sales workflows and lead the implementation of new systems or digital tools to streamline client communication.


**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 4–6 years of progressive experience in catering/event sales, with at least 1\-2 years in a senior or team lead capacity.
* **Skills:**
* **Advanced Negotiation:** 
 Proven ability to close complex contracts and handle difficult client negotiations.
* **Leadership:** 
 Demonstrated experience in training team members and managing performance.
* **Financial Literacy:** 
 Strong understanding of P\&L impact, catering margins, and revenue forecasting.
* **Technical Proficiency:** 
 Advanced knowledge of CRM software and MS Office; experience with hospitality systems is essential.
* **Adaptability:** 
 Ability to step into the Director’s role as needed and handle high\-level escalations calmly.


**Working Conditions** 
* This is a full\-time, high\-engagement role requiring flexibility to work during events, which may include evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Requires a balance between high\-level management and active, on\-the\-floor presence during major events.

data.jd_text:
**Primary Purpose Of The Job**
 To lead, manage and successfully deliver the EPIC Execution Phase for the PS3 BH Field Redevelopment Project – covering both Greenfield and Brownfield scopes— ensuring delivery within cost, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements in line with QatarEnergy's Project Management Framework.
   

  

 The role acts as the Project Manager’s primary deputy, accountable for day‑to‑day coordination, decision‑making, and execution oversight for all EPIC activities across engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 The EPIC Phase Scope of Work includes, but is not limited to:
   

  

* New Production Station (PS3\) bridge connected to the existing complex, consisting of a Process (PS3K) Platform, a Utilities and Living Quarters (PS3L) Platform, MJ Separation and Compression (PS3M), Riser Platform (PS3R), Flare and interconnecting bridges with structural props.
* Brownfield Modifications to existing PS3A,PS3B and PS3C, plus HV Electrical modifications and Civil works at Halul Island.
* A structural Prop and new 4 leg jacket with topside for injection wells.
* Structural Props (support platform) at several remote WHJs.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* At least 10 years in senior Project Management roles delivering large offshore packages.
* Proven leadership delivering multi‑billion USD EPIC contracts involving Topsides, Jackets, Brownfield modifications, offshore construction, installation, and commissioning.
* Work experience in fabrication, offshore construction, and Inspection and Pre\-commissioning activities.
* Strong understanding of engineering design, offshore fabrication, load‑out, T\&I, hook‑up, pre‑commissioning and commissioning.
* Knowledge of offshore codes and standards (API, DNV, ISO) and Shell DEPs.
* Solid experience with risk management, schedule control, earned value, interface management, and change management.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills in multicultural environments.
* Strong decision‑making capability, including under pressure and with limited information.
* Ability to lead large teams (\>150 personnel) across multiple locations and time zones.


**Educational Qualifications**
* B.Sc. in an Engineering Discipline or equivalent from an internationally recognized University with 18 years minimum relevant project experience.

 HR Operations \& Compliance

 Organizational Development
 


* Lead organizational design and restructuring initiatives.

 Experience

* Compensation and benefits.

* Learning and leadership development.
* Employee engagement.

 Key Competencies
 


* Strategic thinking
* Executive presence
* Commercial acumen
* Leadership and influence

* Organizational development
* Change leadership
* Negotiation and conflict resolution
* Communication and presentation skills
* Coaching and mentoring
* Problem solving

 Success Measures
 



 The successful candidate will be expected to:
 


* Build a high\-performing workforce aligned with business strategy.

 If this role is for an investment bank or regulated financial institution in Qatar (similar to the type of organizations you've worked with), I would elevate it further by incorporating:

data.title: Product Delivery Lead
data.raw_snippet: We are looking for a highly technical, execution\-focused Product Delivery Lead to bridge the gap between closed sales and active customer success. In this role, you will own the critical onboarding phase, ensuring that new enterprise customers are seamlessly integrated into our SaaS platform despit
data.jd_text:
We are looking for a highly technical, execution\-focused Product Delivery Lead to bridge the gap between closed sales and active customer success. In this role, you will own the critical onboarding phase, ensuring that new enterprise customers are seamlessly integrated into our SaaS platform despite having highly specific, complex data requirements.
   

  

 You will be the orchestrator who turns a signed contract into active, AI\-driven value. By combining a deep understanding of our product portfolio with expertise in data ingestion techniques and ontology mapping, you will eliminate friction in the setup process. Your ultimate goal is to accelerate the "Time\-to\-Value" for our customers, ensuring they can leverage our Agentic AI tools and sustainability solutions as quickly and effortlessly as possible.
   

  

**Jobs To Be Done**
* Lead the end\-to\-end technical onboarding and implementation of our SaaS solutions for new enterprise customers.
* Serve as the primary bridge between the customer's technical teams and our internal engineering/data teams to define and execute data ingestion strategies.
* Manage complex data requirements, including leading ontology mapping exercises to ensure customer data seamlessly aligns with our AI models.
* Develop, manage, and execute detailed delivery project plans, ensuring timelines, milestones, and customer expectations are consistently met.
* Partner closely with the Business Developer to ensure a smooth handover from the sales cycle and align on strategic customer goals.
* Create repeatable, scalable onboarding playbooks to continuously reduce friction and speed up the delivery lifecycle for future customers.
* Troubleshoot early\-stage data integration roadblocks, ensuring a frictionless transition into "business\-as\-usual" platform usage.


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Scrum Master) are highly valued.
* Bonus points for certifications or coursework in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or Database Management.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in technical delivery, SaaS implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management.
* Proven track record of successfully onboarding B2B enterprise customers with heavy data integration requirements.
* Hands\-on experience navigating data ingestion pipelines, APIs, ETL processes, and complex data mapping/ontology mapping.
* Experience working alongside sales or business development teams in a fast\-paced, high\-growth tech environment.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Delivery Management: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to herd cats, manage scope creep, and keep complex deployments strictly on schedule.
* Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of how data flows between systems. You don't need to write the code, but you must confidently discuss APIs, data ingestion, and ontology mapping with engineers.
* Product Mastery: Rapid ability to deeply understand our entire product portfolio and how different modules interact with customer data.
* Client Management: Excellent executive presence and communication skills. You can translate highly technical data requirements into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: A proactive, "fix\-it\-first" mentality when dealing with data integration bottlenecks.


**KPIs**
* Time\-to\-Value (TTV): Reduction in the average number of days from contract signature to the customer's first successful use of AI insights.
* Onboarding Success Rate: Percentage of customer implementations delivered on time and within scope.
* Data Integration Efficiency: Reduction in manual interventions or rework required during the data mapping and ingestion phases.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): High satisfaction scores specifically tied to the onboarding and delivery experience.
* Playbook Adoption: Successful creation and internal adoption of standardized delivery processes.


**Why Us**
 As a Product Delivery Lead, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of AI for sustainability and drive meaningful impact in the global energy sector. You will work alongside a passionate, mission\-driven team and play a pivotal role in delivering innovative, disruptive solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges.
   

  

**Mobility Information**
 Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country.
   

  

**Job Posting End Date**
 julio\-31\-2026

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary and Purpose** 



* Ensure that the Fleet is managed safely, efficiently, in a professional manner to standards and costs that are in line with the industry best practices.
* Oversee and monitor the overall operational management being provided by third parties.



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Management** 



* Establish and continuously monitor operational standards of ships to ensure delivery of continuous, efficient and safe service to the customer
* Provide marine operational expertise and advice with regards to operational matters. Assist with the assessment of operational risks and mitigations
* Provide guidance and conduct port and terminal due diligence to ensure safe and efficient operations
* Monitors / Ensure high standard day to day marine operational activities of LNG, LPG, FSRU and any chartered in vessels
* Identify sub\-standard operational performance and evaluate alternative methods, systems and contractors to use in place of the obsolete systems



  





**Cargo Management and compliance** 



* Ensure that the vessels are operated in a manner which is safe, reliable and economical meeting the highest industry standards. This shall ensure efficiency in cargo management
* Drive compliance with international, Flag State, legal requirements and all company policies related to shipping operations, safety of navigation and Marine personnel at all times. Oversee/ensure complete compliance with port / terminals requirements, oil / gas majors and ship vetting systems
* Ensure that the trading certification of vessels are valid and avoid failure due to non\-compliance
* Monitor performance of the vessels against charter parties to ensure commercial interests of owners are protected. Prepare defense for performance and off hire claims
* Monitor LNG bespoke developed emergency STS transfer with the third\-party service provider in conjunction with the charterers to be able to deploy promptly if required
* Visit ships as required and instructed by the Operations Manager. Develop reports on the upkeep, operational standards, and effective management of vessels
* Monitors and ensure ship\-shore loading efficiency, passage performance, ship performance, and cargo management are done efficiently
* Ensure terminal compatibility and assurance process completed safely and timely. Ensure compliance with port / terminals requirements, ship vetting systems (oil / gas majors) at all times



  





**Vetting of Vessels** 



* Ensure that vessels in the fleet are vetted successfully by arranging timely SIRE inspections, giving prompt responses to any observations raised, initiate remedial actions and identify and mitigate gaps in policies and procedures
* Manage the entry of details from the VPQ into the SIRE system as well as maintain the relevant vessels particulars data not limited to TMSA and Q88 records



  





**Audits and Ship Inspections** 



* Conduct ship inspections on a regular basis to ensure effective ship management during calls to Ras Laffan or sailing visit. In these visits, he/she shall carry out internal audits not limited to navigational, galley and cargo audits
* Conduct safety / security / environmental and other SHEQ internal audits as applicable
* Supervise the close\-out of audits and inspections of ships in coordination with the SHEQ Division



  





**Safety Management System** 



* Maintain the Safety Management System (SMS) of the organization and consistently focus on improving the quality, efficiency of procedures and accuracy
* Brief new senior officers before they join the vessels with regards to the Safety Management System, company policies, vessel operations and specific charterers’ requirements
* Supervise and carry out security duties as per ISPS code if requested by management



  





**Monitor Communication:** 



* Confirm owned vessels managed by third party is operated efficiently in line with Master Service agreement, Owners instructions, charterer’s instruction and TCP



  





**Voyage Planning** 



* Supervise the voyage planning and performance process for the vessels managed by NSQL to ensure compliance with the requirements of the charterer. Help the organization to avoid performance related claims and provide support in challenging the claims in case they are raised



  





**Terminal Approval** 



* Participate actively. ship shore interface and compatibly studies Liaise with all related parties such as agents, charterers and terminals and provide all relevant information for the Master to assess the suitability of the berth
* Carry out in\-house mooring analysis Studies



  





**Incident investigations and Risk Assessment** 



* Lead investigations into incidents that occurred and ensure that incidents are successfully closed out in a timely manner in coordination with the SHEQ Division
* Conduct safety risk assessment and environmental impact assessment for vessel operations in line with Maritime standard / best industry practice



  





**Emergency Response Plan:** 



* Perform duties and functions as per the Emergency Response Plan and as directed by the Incident Commander



  





  





**Qualifications, Experience and Job** 




  





**Skills Qualifications** 



* Degree in Nautical Science or any other related field
* Master Mariner Certificate of competence and all associated courses with this competence certification.



  





**Experience:** 



* A minimum of 12 years’ experience including 3 years’ as Master on LNG/LPG. At least 4 years’ in a head office management position of a large gas/oil shipping company.
* Prior shore base experience in similar role for at least 2 years or Marine Operational Supt experience for at least 8 year managing LNG/LPG vessels.
* Experience of working with personnel from different cultures (ship owners and ship crews)



  





**Job Specific Skills:** 



* Fully conversant with international and national statutory requirements of the Maritime industry (SOLAS, ISM, MARPOL, ISPS, SOPEP, ISOs)
* Training and knowledge of emergency response procedures, ship vetting, ship inspection is essential.
* Auditing skills\- Lead ISO, ISM, ISPS auditor
* Computer literate\- Microsoft suite of products

 The CEO shall build an inspirational company culture, provide motivating leadership to the executive team, and establish a positive working relationship with Board Members and Employees.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic
 *(Describes long\-term tasks to deliver organizational expectations)***



* Develops high\-quality business strategies and plans ensuring their alignment with short and long\-term objectives.
* Oversees all operations and business activities to ensure they produce the desired results and are consistent with the overall strategy and mission.
* Makes high\-quality investment decisions to advance the business and increase profits.
* Enforces adherence to legal guidelines and Company policies to maintain the company’s legality and business ethics.
* Evaluates and advises on the impact of medium to long\-term planning, introduction of new programs/strategies, and regulatory action.



  





**Tactical
 *(Refers to specific tasks or actions to be undertaken to accomplish a strategy)***



* Reviews financial and non\-financial reports to devise solutions or improvements.
* Analyzes problematic situations and occurrences and provides solutions to ensure company survival and growth.
* Maintains a sound knowledge of relevant markets and industry of the company.
* Implements and enforces policies and procedures of the Company through systems that improve the overall operation and effectiveness of the organization.
* Ensures that programs deliver on time, in full, to budget, to quality standards, to customers’ expectations, and with the most effective use of the Company's resources.
* Evaluates business challenges and takes action to mitigate risks and develop opportunities.
* Oversees the development of company targets and objectives that support the business and its operations, taking into consideration economic conditions and other relevant factors.
* Oversees all financial issues in cooperation with the Finance Director, including reporting and monitoring of company performance metrics.



  





**People
 *(Outlines duties that promote workplace harmony, productivity, and professional growth***

* Builds trust relations with key partners and stakeholders and acts as a point of contact for important shareholders.

 The CEO ensures compliance with all relevant health, safety, environmental, and quality management policies, procedures, and controls across the organization to ensure employee health and safety is maintained and a responsible environment is created for the delivery of high\-quality products and services.
 



  





**Requirements:** 



* Master's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Defense Studies, or a related discipline (preferred).

* Minimum 8\+ years of executive leadership experience within the defense, security, aerospace, or advanced\-technology sectors at Executive or CEO level.
* Demonstrable track record of capturing and delivering major defense programs, including government / FMS / direct\-commercial contracts.
* Experience operating within a joint\-venture structure involving a sovereign / strategic shareholder and a global defense OEM is highly desirable.
* Proven international business experience, with credibility across both government end\-users and global industrial partners.
* Defense Business Development \& Capture Management
* Program \& Operations Management (defense\-grade)
* Strategic Planning \& P\&L Leadership
* Governance, Export\-Control \& Compliance
* Industrial Security \& Risk Management
* Financial Acumen and Capital Allocation
* Tact, Diplomacy, and Cross\-Cultural Fluency
* Discretion and Sound Judgment in Sensitive Environments
* Strong Government and Stakeholder Relationship Skills
* Values\-driven, with Unimpeachable Integrity
* Decisive Leader under Pressure
* Inspires Initiative and Builds High\-Performing Teams

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
* Responsible for implementation of Target Operating Model (TOM) across the International Branches and Subsidiaries
* Conduct Domain Assessment, Evaluation and Gap Analysis, Regulatory requirements, and report periodically
* Support EVP / direct manager in governance implementation and day\-to\-day governance responsibilities over branches and subsidiaries.
* Assist in reviewing and implementing Policies \& Procedures re\-engineering,
* Coordinate various projects to grow the usage of the Group’s International banking branches / products in line with corporate initiatives.
* Assist in implementing Quality assurance framework in all designated countries.
* Support Domain Owner to Control and Monitor all ongoing implementation of new products, systems and processes in designated countries.

* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
